messages.content: Good evening, my lord. How may I assist you tonight?

A caesarean section, commonly called a C‑section, is a surgical procedure in which a baby is delivered through an incision made in the mother’s abdomen and uterus. The operation is performed when a vaginal birth would pose significant risk to either the mother or the child, such as in cases of fetal distress, abnormal presentation, maternal health complications, or certain obstetric conditions. The incision is closed after the delivery, and recovery typically requires several weeks of rest and medical monitoring.
I have taken note of the record state you provided, my lord. How may I further serve our house?
